title: Sabotage City
description:
Sabotage City is a satirical city destroyer game where you destroy cities instead of building

them. You work for Sabotage City, a demolition company contracted by mayors to drive out the people of their cities.

• Fast paced money management gameplay with a high skill ceiling, speedrunning tools, and a freeplay mode for replayability.

• Different gimmicks that spice up the gameplay experience. like being able to hire workers for extra money, or controlling the press to rile up the people. All with the end goal of making the citizens leave.

• A full story mode campaign with 20+ locations to destroy,  and a full plot with multiple characters, locations, and different routes to take the story.

• Web 1.0 web page inspired menus and shops. Instead of a normal shop menu the game uses a computer with charming 90s style websites that give advice on how to get better, helps you buy tickets to the cities you destroy, and give backstory to the world of the game.

• Multiple endings. 

• Codes and ciphers to discover and solve. The game is packed with loads of hidden puzzles and things to solve all across it.

• And more!
description_short: Sabotage city takes the idea of a city builder and flips it on its head, making a city destroyer game. You are an average citizen hired to work for a gigantic demolition company, little to find out the cities are less than abandoned…
